# CAPSTONE_ASL model integration

Phase-aware isolated-ASL inference code, checkpoints, and label map from
[H29-crypto/CAPSTONE_ASL](https://github.com/H29-crypto/CAPSTONE_ASL), revision
`bb4b8faff4a09bba8353b6607b7cd4aec279e78c`.

Copyright (c) 2026 Hamdi. Used under the MIT License in `LICENSE`.

The upstream training videos are not included. Dataset rights remain with their
original owners. HandSpeak sends extracted hand and upper-body coordinates to
this server for in-memory inference; camera video is not uploaded or stored.
